---
title: "Contact"
---

Interested in my writing, or just want to say hi? Send me a message and I'd love to hear from you!

```{=html}
<form class="contact-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/xbggeqzq" method="POST" accept-charset="utf-8">
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="full-name" class="form-label">Full name</label>
    <input type="text" class="form-control" name="name" id="full-name" placeholder="First and last" required>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="email-address" class="form-label">Email address</label>
    <input type="email" class="form-control" name="_replyto" id="email-address" placeholder="you@example.com" required>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="message" class="form-label">Message</label>
    <textarea class="form-control" rows="6" name="message" id="message" placeholder="Your message" required></textarea>
  </div>
  <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="Message from your website">
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Send message</button>
</form>
```
